children: Rwanda’s economy continued to grow at a brisk pace in Q2, expanding 9.4% from a year earlier after a 10% jump in the previous period.
Industry was the main engine of growth, surging 18%, supported by strong performances in construction (+24%), mining (+26%) and manufacturing (+10%).
Within the latter, metal products, machinery and equipment stood out, with output surging 51%.
Non-metallic mineral products rose 22%, while textiles, clothing and leather products increased 13%.
Services and agriculture posted more modest gains of 7% and 4%, respectively.
On a quarterly basis, the GDP surged by 9%, fully reversing the 9% decline seen in the previous quarter.

title: Rwanda's Economy Keeps Solid Pace of Growth
